sections.heading: C - Bicycles and Commercial Motor Vehicles
sections.markdown:
## C - Bicycles and Commercial Motor Vehicles

FACT_ID: sec10-F01 | anchor: A01
Bikes count as vehicles with full road rights off limited ways, may exit lanes for narrow roads, hazards, and lefts, may own narrow lanes, and yield to walkers on sidewalks [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-F02 | anchor: A01
Drivers clear bikes by three feet with slowed care, and pass two-lane riders like slow vehicles only when safe [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-F03 | anchor: A01
Crossings treat riders as straight-through vehicles owed yields, and lane-crossing turns finish behind them [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-F04 | anchor: A01
Drivers never tailgate, high-beam, door, or horn-startle riders [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-F05 | anchor: A02
Riders obey all controls, slow into lanes or right edges, own full lanes for lefts, passes, hazards, and narrows, may left-ride wide one-ways, and hand-signal turns [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec10-F06 | anchor: A02
Riders never hitch vehicles, and sidewalk riders hold walker rights while yielding and signaling passes audibly [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec10-F07 | anchor: A02
Night riders shine white 500 feet ahead and red 600 behind, brake 25 feet from 10 MPH, and helmet all under-16 riders [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec10-F08 | anchor: A02
Under-four or 40-pound riders need child carriers, and carriers never sit unattended off rider control [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec10-F09 | anchor: A02
Groups cap two-abreast off bike paths and single up when blocking, roadways ban dual earbuds, and drink and drugs ban biking [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec10-F10 | anchor: A02
Tips helmet every age, grip both bars, glance before shifting, flash neon and reflective gear, and pocket phones [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec10-F11 | anchor: A02
Big rigs blind front, rear, and both flanks, hiding whole cars despite mirror banks [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec10-F12 | anchor: A02
Rig followers never tailgate, space upgrades leftward for visibility, and dim beams at night [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0090]

items.why: Section ten is sharing-rule recall served by standard flashcards and quizzes; no separate practice mode is needed.

corpus_stability.reason: The Official Florida Driver License Handbook is a dated revision (rev. 08/2023) reissued at most annually, so sharing-the-road rules change at most once per year.
